data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 雨夜车站的并肩伞下
data.description: 夜雨蒙蒙的学园轻轨月台，路灯在潮湿的水泥地面倒映出暖黄色的波光。诺亚身着优雅的米色风衣，长发被微风拂起。她撑着一把透明雨伞，将伞面偏向老师身侧，侧身仰望，紫罗兰眼眸在雨丝与暖光交织中泛着脉脉温情。
data.location: rainy train platform under warm streetlamps

data.promptProse: Noa tilts the clear umbrella from the left, her long white hair, lavender eyes and halo visible above a beige trench coat. The teacher beside her is a short-haired man in a red-brown corduroy rain jacket with square glasses and an uncovered head. Warm station lamps reflect off the platform below their feet.
